segments.title: Your iPhone can WATCH a price
segments.say: Your iPhone can watch a product page for you before Black Friday.

segments.title: Tap the menu, then Notify Me
segments.say: Open the page in Safari, tap the menu button left of the address bar, then tap Notify Me.

segments.title: Say what to look for
segments.say: Type what Safari should look for, like a price drop.

segments.title: Hourly, daily, weekly
segments.say: Choose how often it checks. The fastest is once an hour.

segments.title: Needs iOS 27
segments.sub: Not tested by us · **Tom's Guide, Cult of Mac**
segments.say: It's part of Safari in iOS twenty-seven. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 16 tomorrow.
